name: test_delivery_timestamp_supports_every_portal_format[2026-08-14-12:00:00 PM-12]
description:
Objective: Delivery timestamp supports every portal format — data partition: date_text='2026-08-14', hour=12, time_text='12:00:00 PM'.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/notifications/test_notification_portal_page.py.
3. Apply the exact parameter partition recorded in Test Data: {"date_text": "2026-08-14", "hour": 12, "time_text": "12:00:00 PM"}
4. Execute `test_delivery_timestamp_supports_every_portal_format` exactly as defined in tests/unit/notifications/test_notification_portal_page.py:74.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `actual == local.astimezone(timezone.utc)`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Delivery timestamp supports every portal format.
2. The outcome applies specifically to the recorded partition: {"date_text": "2026-08-14", "hour": 12, "time_text": "12:00:00 PM"}
3. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `actual == local.astimezone(timezone.utc)`.
4. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
